verified_facts.text: The hotel is rooted in the Villard Mansion, built by Henry Villard in Italian Renaissance Revival style and designed by McKim, Mead & White.

verified_facts.text: Every Saturday at 10 am, the Palace Historian leads a one-hour guided tour of the Villard Mansion, complimentary to guests.

verified_facts.text: The Gilded Age history tour is complimentary to guests and gathers in the Grand Lobby.
